name: 3D Pyramid Compressor
definition: A compression technique for confocal microscopic image sequences that treats a stack of 2D slices as a 3D volume, exploiting multi-dimensional redundancy using a 3D differential image pyramid structure combined with vector quantization (VQ).
summary: The 3D Pyramid Compressor is a lossy compression technique for confocal microscopy that exploits static 3D spatial correlation via a differential pyramid and vector quantization, unlike video coders using planar motion.
